review_scope: Read-only independent review of the two production files in the target manifest; no tests read/run, edits, or production operations.

findings.finding: An identity-matching complete/handoff_accepted attempt with missing/unreadable/hash-invalid output could fall through to a valid same-invocation failure_handoff and be recorded as stage_failure_handoff, hiding the invalid formal success output.
findings.recommendation: When an identity-matching successful attempt has formal_output_observation, append a cause-bearing gap and continue without invoking failure_handoff. Keep failure handoff available for non-success attempts.

scope_limitations: The report evidence allowlist validator and HTML renderer are in imported reporting.py, which was outside the two permitted source files; reviewer could not independently verify that implementation.
